item.text: The diff against the pinned commit shows the regression removed mutex protection and changed a pointer receiver to a value receiver that would copy the mutex. I’m restoring that production behavior now.

I’m also changing `ConfigDirFiles` back to a pointer receiver because copying a parser with a mutex would be both unsafe and against the intended ownership model.
